title: Blind Discovery Diagnostic
goal_description: Navigate smoothly through obstacles to reach target without collision within timeout

hypotheses.title: Increasing Repulsion Gain
hypotheses.statement: Increasing the repulsion gain will make the robot more responsive to obstacles, potentially reducing the risk of collision and improving navigation.
hypotheses.mechanism: The repulsion gain affects how strongly the robot avoids obstacles. Higher values make the robot more cautious and slower near obstacles.

hypotheses.title: Reducing Safety Margin
hypotheses.statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to come closer to obstacles, potentially reducing the total duration and improving the proximity to the target.
hypotheses.mechanism: The safety margin defines the minimum distance the robot should maintain from obstacles to ensure safety. Lowering this value can make the robot more aggressive in its path planning.

action_log.message: Formulated 2 competing testable hypotheses grounded in physical dynamics.
